title: Settings building blocks
description: Definitions shared by the settings schemas (master plan section 14.2, Settings and client preferences), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:settings:shared:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own. It depends on nothing outside schemas/common. Every object in the settings schemas is closed (additionalProperties false) and no member can hold a secret, a URL, a path, a free-form tool or server definition, a scope, a role, a confirmation switch, a budget or a provider: a setting can only select among things the operator approved, switch something off for itself, or ask for MORE confirmation. Anything else is a member that does not exist, and a document that names one is refused whole.

languageTag.title: Language tag
languageTag.description: A BCP 47 tag in canonical case: a lower-case 2 or 3 letter language, an optional Title-case 4 letter script and an optional upper-case 2 letter or 3 digit region (en, it, pt-BR, zh-Hant-TW). The service also checks it against the languages the application's active package supports.

profileId.title: Model profile ID
profileId.description: The id of an approved model and resource profile (lite, balanced, experimental-4g, ...): lower case letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 32 characters, never a URL, a path, a provider id with an underscore or a minted pprf_ id. The operator decides which profiles are approved (the settings.approved_profiles configuration); a profile that is not approved is refused whatever its spelling.

voiceId.title: Voice ID
voiceId.description: The id of an installed voice (lower case letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, 1 to 64 characters). It names a voice; it never holds a path, a URL or a key.

riskLevel.title: Risk level
riskLevel.description: The risk scale of master plan 11.4: 0 read, 1 reversible, 2 consequential, 3 privileged.

retentionDays.title: History retention in days
retentionDays.description: How many days conversation history is kept: 1 to 3650. The operator's settings.max_history_retention_days is a ceiling; a longer value is refused and, whatever is stored, the effective retention never exceeds the shortest value any level states.

fileMegabytes.title: Attachment size limit in megabytes
fileMegabytes.description: The largest single attachment in whole megabytes: 1 to 1024. The operator's settings.max_attachment_mb is a ceiling.

capabilitySwitches.title: Capability switches
capabilitySwitches.description: The capabilities this level switches OFF. There is no list that switches one on: what the model may use is decided by the policy gateway from the package, the token and the host policy, and a setting can only narrow it. Every id must be one the caller is itself allowed to use (an undeclared, admin-only or out-of-scope id is refused, the same answer for all three so the inventory cannot be probed). Levels add up: a capability that any level switches off is off.

disabled.description: Capability IDs switched off, at most 64, no duplicates.

confirmationRaise.title: Extra confirmation
confirmationRaise.description: Ask for an explicit confirmation from this risk level up, in ADDITION to what the platform already requires. The platform floor (level 2 needs an explicit confirmation, level 3 the host application's own step-up) is not a setting and cannot be lowered, switched off or bypassed; this member can only add. Levels combine by taking the LOWEST threshold, so a user can never relax what a tenant or the deployment asked for.

policyVoice.title: Voice policy
policyVoice.description: Whether voice may be used under this level. Voice is off until the deployment level allows it; a lower level can only keep that or switch it off.

allowed.description: True permits voice for everyone below this level.

policyHistory.title: History policy
policyHistory.description: Retention and export of conversation history. Retention is a ceiling for the levels below (the shortest wins); export is off until the deployment level allows it and any level below can switch it off.

export_allowed.description: True permits exporting one's own history, under the host's authorisation.

policyPrivacy.title: Privacy policy
policyPrivacy.description: Whether the transcript of a conversation may be stored at all. On unless a level switches it off.

transcript_allowed.description: False stops the transcript being kept; the structured session state the core needs to continue a turn is unaffected.

policyAttachments.title: Attachment policy
policyAttachments.description: Whether attachments may be uploaded and how large one may be. Off until the deployment level allows it; the size is a ceiling (the smallest wins).

allowed.description: True permits attachments for everyone below this level.

policyNotifications.title: Notification policy
policyNotifications.description: Whether notifications may be raised. On unless a level switches it off.

allowed.description: False switches notifications off for everyone below this level.

notificationEvent.title: Notification event
notificationEvent.description: An event a client may be notified about.

citationDisplay.title: Citation display
citationDisplay.description: How a client shows the sources of an answer. Citations themselves are never optional (master plan 3 rule 9); this is only how they are laid out.

streamUnit.title: Streaming unit
streamUnit.description: How much text a streamed answer delivers at a time.

decidedBy.title: Which level decided a value
decidedBy.description: default (nothing stated it), deployment, tenant, user, or operator (a ceiling from the operator's configuration capped it).
